path.noNext: All caught up — start a drill or browse the library.

crossIntro.title: The Cross
crossIntro.body: The cross is the first step of CFOP: build a plus-shape of one colour on the bottom layer with its edge pieces matched to neighbouring centres. Aim for ≤ 8 moves and to look ahead to your first F2L pair while you solve it.

crossPlanning.title: Planning the Cross
crossPlanning.body: Use your 15-second inspection: locate all four cross edges, plan moves that don't disturb edges you've already solved, and watch where the first F2L corner+edge pair will end up so you can attack it without pause.

f2lShapes.title: Three shapes of F2L
f2lShapes.body: Every F2L pair sits in one of three families: pair joined in the top, pair split in the top, or pair stuck in the slot. Recognise which family you have first; the right move follows.

f2lJoined.title: Pair joined in the top
f2lJoined.body: Place the joined pair above its empty slot, then insert with U R U' R' (or the mirrored U' L' U L). Practise from every angle.

f2lSplit.title: Pair split in the top
f2lSplit.body: Bring the corner and edge together using U-moves, then insert. The split case is twelve cases; intuitively you 'unstuck' them by aligning corner-above-slot first.

f2lStuck.title: Stuck in the slot
f2lStuck.body: If the corner or edge is already in the slot but wrong, extract it (R U' R' or similar) to put it back in the top layer, then re-solve as a joined or split case.

eoLine.desc: A horizontal line of oriented edges across the top.
